messages:
incident-bot: PAGED: sev2 - increased embed latency in us-west-2 (alerts from 03:12 -> 03:17 UTC). auto-escalation: page to #incidents.

maddie_oncall: seeing spikes on the dashboard, thanks for the page. i'm on it and attaching current perf trace.

kevin_eng: thx @maddie, can you confirm if error-rate or tail-latency is driving customer impact? any customers paged?

maddie_oncall: error-rate steady, tail P99 for embed endpoint up from 120ms -> 1.2s. a couple of enterprise requests retried by clients; CS has 1 active ticket (cust: AcmePay).

alan_sre: looking at infra, a rollout to dedicated pool `dedicated-g4-21` at 03:05 had a kernel mismatch fallback (quantized backend -> float path) causing CPU fallback under load. agent logs: `kernel_select: fallback=true`.

jordan_runtime: exact, saw many requests fall back to cpu decode for hot path. temp mitigation: i've toggled routing policy to prefer stable-gpu variants for tiered customers (rolled to 2 zones).

maddie_oncall: mitigation looks effective, p99 dropping to ~180ms after 03:22. leaving page open for post-incident wrap.

incident-bot: ACTION: create post-incident review in 24h with owners: root-cause, remediation, customer-comm. Use template `/incident create`.

kevin_eng: i'll schedule a 1hr postmortem tomorrow 10:00 UTC. @sarah_pmo please invite CS SEs for AcmePay comms alignment.

sarah_pmo: noted, will invite and prepare customer impact summary. i also want remediation notes tied to Q4 reliability OKRs.

maddie_oncall: initial action items:
- m1: revert/lock kernel rollout for `dedicated-g4-21` and add staged canary (owner: alan_sre) - size: M
- m2: add runtime guard to refuse fallback to cpu decode at high QPS (owner: jordan_runtime) - size: L
- m3: customer comm draft + credit assessment (owner: sarah_pmo) - size: S
- m4: add alert on kernel_select:fallback rate > 0.5% (owner: kevin_eng) - size: S

alan_sre: ack m1, will open infra ticket and target patch tomorrow EOD. estimate 2 dev-days (M).

jordan_runtime: m2 is bigger — need design + perf tests. i'll break into sub-tasks: design (S), impl (M), rollout (M). overall L.

kevin_eng: m4 i can do today, adding metric and scoreboard. low risk.

sarah_pmo: m3 I'll prepare a one-pager + suggested credit on AcmePay; size S. Recommend holding external comm until root cause confirmed.

kevin_eng: priority-wise: P0 = prevent recurrence (m1 + m2), P1 = detection/alerts (m4), P2 = customer comm (m3) given mitigation already reduced impact.

maddie_oncall: agree on priorities. for quarterly planning, @sarah_pmo can we map m1/m2 to Q4 reliability epic and request 1 sprint buffer for perf testing?

sarah_pmo: yes, i'll flag them as Q4 reliability:high and ask PM to carve capacity. will include suggested acceptance criteria (no CPU fallbacks at 99th under production load).

incident-bot: NOTE: postmortem draft assigned to kevin_eng. Reminder: include timeline, RCA, action items with owners, sizes, and rollout plan.

kevin_eng: working on draft now. i'll link tickets and propose a canary rollout cadence. target final postmortem by EOD day after the review.

maddie_oncall: follow-up: if anyone picks up a subtask, ping here with ticket number. keeping handoff tight so nothing slips into backlog. :thumbsup:

alan_sre: created INF-3221 for kernel rollback + staged canary. ETA: 48h.

jordan_runtime: created RNT-2110 for runtime guard design; will update w/ perf bench next week.

sarah_pmo: created COMM-789 for customer comm draft and credit calc.

kevin_eng: noted all tickets. closing live page at 03:30 UTC. moving thread to post-incident follow-up channel in 1h.

maddie_oncall: thanks team. good mitigation and quick handoff. we'll review action sizing in the postmortem meeting.
